sources.entry: Vitals - Native macOS system monitor for Apple Silicon, SMC sensors, processes, disks, network and system health.

summary.one_liner: Vitals is a native, open-source macOS system monitor focused on Apple Silicon, covering CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, SMC sensors, processes, disks, network, SMART and system health.
keywords: see what is slowing my mac
use_cases: see which process is using CPU or energy on a Mac
monitor Apple Silicon P/E cores, GPU and Neural Engine
read SMC temperatures, fan speeds and power
find large files and folders on disk with a treemap
check disk SMART status and network interface traffic
run CPU, memory and disk benchmarks on a Mac
notable: Privileged helper daemon (online.equishow.vitals.helper) gives full process data and powermetrics readings without repeated password prompts
Per-device entries for each P/E core cluster, each physical disk and each network interface, including Wi-Fi SSID and VPN profile
Disk space scanner uses getattrlistbulk in parallel with treemap drill-down and zoom
Hover over graphs to rewind the process list to that moment
No Electron, no telemetry, no third-party dependencies
caveats: Privileged helper requires an Apple Development certificate to build; without one only an ad-hoc signed app runs and the helper cannot be installed
On macOS 26/27 CPU, GPU and Neural Engine power fields show dashes without the helper
Releases are signed with a development certificate, so macOS may show a malware warning until notarized builds are published
Requires Xcode 15+ (Swift 5.9+) to build from source
